scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
short_description: Provides cashless hospitalisation coverage for eligible poor and vulnerable families for secondary and tertiary healthcare services.
eligibility: Eligibility is based on government-defined deprivation and occupational criteria for rural and urban beneficiaries.

short_description: A maternity benefit scheme providing financial support to eligible pregnant and lactating women.
eligibility: The scheme covers eligible women from specified socially and economically disadvantaged categories, subject to the current scheme guidelines.

short_description: A safe motherhood intervention under the National Health Mission that promotes institutional delivery and aims to reduce maternal and neonatal mortality.
eligibility: Eligibility for cash assistance depends on the applicable state category and beneficiary criteria, including conditions related to BPL, SC/ST status and institutional delivery.

short_description: Provides free and cashless delivery services and healthcare entitlements for pregnant women and sick newborns and infants in public health institutions.
eligibility: Pregnant women accessing public health institutions and eligible sick newborns and infants can receive services according to the programme guidelines.

short_description: Provides a minimum package of antenatal care services to pregnant women through government health facilities, with special attention to identifying high-risk pregnancies.
eligibility: Pregnant women can access the programme's antenatal care services at participating government health facilities according to programme guidelines.
